names: BC Liquor Distribution Branch (BC Cannabis Wholesale)
delivery: a notification listing the invoices before each withdrawal: “This notification will confirm the amount and date of the pre-authorized withdrawal; will provide a list of all invoices for goods ordered & other account adjustments and will provide BCLDB customer information.”
payment: by pre-authorized debit from the store's bank account, for each order: “The amount and frequency of the withdrawal is dependent on the payor’s online order for goods authorized through the BC LDB Wholesale website” … “The biller will provide PAD pre-notification, 1 – 2 business days prior to the withdrawal date.”
